description_en: Enables the Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) feature for an ApsaraDB for Tair (Redis OSS-Compatible) database instance and supports custom keys
description_zh: 为云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例开启透明数据加密TDE功能，支持自定义密钥
name: ModifyInstanceTDE

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473778.html operation to query instance ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable TDE. Valid value: Enabled.
After TDE is enabled, it cannot be disabled. Evaluate the impact on your business before you enable TDE. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/265913.html
parameters.help_zh:
开启TDE功能，取值：Enabled。
TDE功能开启后暂不支持关闭，开启前请评估是否影响业务。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/265913.html
parameters.name: tde_status

parameters.help_en:
The encryption algorithm. Default value: AES-CTR-256.
This parameter is available only when the TDEStatus parameter is set to Enabled
parameters.help_zh:
加密算法，默认AES-CTR-256。
当TDEStatus参数取值为Enabled时，本参数才可用
parameters.name: encryption_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the custom key. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473860.html operation to query the ID.

If you do not specify this parameter, https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28935.html automatically generates a key.
To create a custom key, you can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28947.html operation of Key Management Service
parameters.help_zh:
自定义密钥ID，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473860.html获取。

如果不传入本参数，则由https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28935.html自动生成密钥。
如需创建自定义密钥，您可以调用密钥管理服务的https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28947.html接口
parameters.name: encryption_key

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the global resource descriptor ARN (Alibaba Cloud Resource Name) of the role to be authorized. After the authorization is complete, you can use the related Key Management Service. Format: `acs:ram::$accountID:role/$roleName`.

`$accountID`: the ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You can logon to the Alibaba Cloud Management Console, move the mouse over the profile picture in the upper-right corner, and then click Security Settings to view the ID.
`$roleName`: the name of the RAM role. Set the value to AliyunRdsInstanceEncryptionDefaultRole
parameters.help_zh:
指定待授权角色的全局资源描述符ARN（Alibaba Cloud Resource Name）信息，完成授权后即可使用相关密钥管理服务，格式：`acs:ram::$accountID:role/$roleName` 。

`$accountID`：云账号ID。您可以登录阿里云控制台，将鼠标悬停在右上角头像的位置，单击安全设置进行查看。
`$roleName`：RAM角色名称，取值固定为：AliyunRdsInstanceEncryptionDefaultRole
parameters.name: role_arn
